materials: IELTS Liz (website/YouTube) for writing and speaking strategy
Official band descriptors for Writing and Speaking
dailyCore: Every session: 1 listening section (10 min) + 1 speaking Part 2 cue card recorded and replayed (5 min).

weeks.goal: Learn the format and scoring; find your gaps

days.tasks: Learn the 4-paragraph essay structure. Write one essay, 40 min timed.
Learn question types (True/False/Not Given, matching headings). 1 passage, 20 min.
Learn the overview + key features structure. 1 chart, 20 min.
1 full test, review every mistake (spelling counts).
Rewrite Sunday's essay using feedback against the band descriptors.
Full timed test. Log scores.
Mistake log, useful phrases list, speaking Part 1 topics.

weeks.goal: Timed practice everywhere; writing feedback loop

days.tasks: Opinion essay, 40 min. Get feedback.
2 passages, 40 min.
Process diagram or map, 20 min.
Parts 1–3 with a partner or recorded; time Part 2 at 2 min.
Rewrite weakest paragraph from this week.
Full timed test. Log scores.
Mistake log; vocabulary for common topics (environment, tech, education).

weeks.goal: Exam conditions on computer; fix the weakest skill

days.tasks: Both tasks back to back, 60 min, typed.
Full reading section, 60 min, on screen.
Extra practice on your lowest-scoring skill.
Full mock speaking, recorded. Check fluency and range.
Rewrite one Task 2 for band 7 vocabulary and cohesion.
Full timed test typed on computer. Log scores.
Mistake log review.
Last full timed test.
Go through the mock's mistakes only.
One Task 2, then stop writing practice.
Listening section + speaking warm-up only.
Logistics: ID, route, sleep early.
Light speaking warm-up.
Good luck.
